title: Guyyaa Agarsiisa Xumuraa
intro: Gareen namoota ogummaa qaban agarsiisa aangoo guddaa irratti kan waamaman, dhugaa hin eegamne kan jireenya isaanii bara baraan jijjiiru tokko isaan mudate.
clues: Ogummaa keenyaan, gooftota fakkeessaa fi malaan beekamna turre.
Morkataa ulee salphaa qabate tokko akka wal dura dhaabbannu bulchaan nu waamame.
Dhugaa yommuu arginu, Gooftaa adunyaatti amanuu labsinee sujuuda keessatti kufne.
Abbaan irree sun adabbii cimaa nu doorsise, nuti garuu hin raafamne.
Mallattoo ifa ta’e erga arginee booda ergaa sanatti warra jalqaba amanne keessaa tokko turre.
Amantii keenyaaf wareegamne, garuu warra qajeelota waliin Jannata seenuuf jalqaba taana.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
